title: Tall white underground facilities and hangars at the north end of Indian Springs Valley
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tall white underground facilities and hangars at the north end of Indian Springs Valley, about 1960s at North end of Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: North end of Indian Springs Valley, Nevada

tellings.quote: Hall claims that the tall whites lived in underground facilities at the north end of Indian Springs Valley, complete with hangers for their craft, a story bearing striking resemblance to that of Bob Lazar.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells the claims of Charles Hall, a man who says he spent years in the 1960s near Area 51, a secret US military base in Nevada, alongside tall, pale beings he calls the tall whites. Michels says Hall claims these beings lived in underground facilities at the north end of Indian Springs Valley, with hangars for their craft. Michels notes the story closely resembles one told by another man, Bob Lazar, and if true it would mean aliens were living on a US military site.
